8fdbe570f8dfccec53c8dd919d2a0e2897245772.ja: 指定主体が、閉じたtargetで記述する設定や事柄を思考の対象として取り上げ、関係や帰結を検討する。実際の実験・物理的実現、targetの真理への同意、信念の獲得とは区別する。targetを説明のない語名として扱わず、内容型を保持した記述として受け取る。
8fdbe570f8dfccec53c8dd919d2a0e2897245772.en: The designated subject takes as an object of thought settings and matters described in a closed target, examining relations and consequences. This is distinguished from actual experiments or physical realization, from agreement with the truth of the target, and from the acquisition of belief. The target is treated not as a name without explanation but as a description retaining its content type.

8fe55c4879e4468c43227a5ca3748121e04818b0.ja: 列挙が完了し、候補が一種類である。内容の真理を含意しない。
8fe55c4879e4468c43227a5ca3748121e04818b0.en: Enumeration is complete and the candidate is of one type. This does not entail truth of content.

900304061b1545665ec3c6e5a58adf3534531842.ja: 列挙が完了しており候補がない。内容の否定ではない。
900304061b1545665ec3c6e5a58adf3534531842.en: The enumeration is complete and there are no candidates. This is not a negation of content.

9004022191038728e409c868c931d57d6e22e6f5.ja: 同じ人・行為・目標記述・文脈を保持し、態度・試み・実行・成功を区別する。
9004022191038728e409c868c931d57d6e22e6f5.en: Maintaining the same person, action, goal description, and context, distinguishing attitude, attempt, execution, and success.

90068c46a85290e49513002c39b91a07a23fbcd5.ja: 説明対象の集団を構成する人々の列。集団という対象と列の対応を与え、割合の計算には既存の母集団条件も要求する。
90068c46a85290e49513002c39b91a07a23fbcd5.en: A sequence of individuals constituting the target population. This provides correspondence between the population as an object and the sequence, and existing population conditions are also required for calculating proportions.

9027b7c7991a8e059ba1cb0ffe23c81fbd83c816.ja: context: 発生・参加・作用または相互関係を評価する同じ状況。
9027b7c7991a8e059ba1cb0ffe23c81fbd83c816.en: context: The same situation in which occurrence, participation, action, or mutual relations are evaluated.

903240dafcb6c5614eaa20cdd1af083b0c90083c.ja: 候補履歴が指定した物理系の状態変化を記述するという対応。実際にその変化が起きたことは含意しない。
903240dafcb6c5614eaa20cdd1af083b0c90083c.en: The correspondence that a candidate history describes the state change of the specified physical system. It does not imply that the change actually occurred.

906a460d311d88a7ba41cf1de7a283df2cd2c89c.ja: 本人について実現する目標の性質記述
906a460d311d88a7ba41cf1de7a283df2cd2c89c.en: The nature description of the goal to be realized about the person

906a53846729a7230028ecf7c51acec15c99dd1e.ja: 先行する課題への解に、記述された条件が必要だと述べる箇所の対応。解の発見や存在は含意しない。
906a53846729a7230028ecf7c51acec15c99dd1e.en: Correspondence to a place where it is stated that the described condition is necessary for the solution to a preceding task. Discovery or existence of the solution is not implied.

909f1891cfe3240677fa7144a02dd5d214ecf7eb.ja: 同じfirstに対するsecondの全配置点・全時点に共通に試す速度ベクトルのaxis成分。数値はlengthunit/timeunitで表し、点又は時点を引数に取って速度を選び直さない。正・負・零を許す候補値であり、一定速度の成立は変位条件で別に要求する。
909f1891cfe3240677fa7144a02dd5d214ecf7eb.en: The axis components of a velocity vector commonly tested for all placement points and all time points of second relative to the same first. The numerical values are expressed in lengthunit/timeunit, and the velocity is not reselected by taking a point or time point as an argument. They are candidate values allowing positive, negative, and zero, while the holding of constant velocity is separately required by displacement conditions.

90a3a8807a514c6237b91b7907097ff8952f950b.ja: 基準文脈で対象に含まれる命題的部分が、評価状況で全て真である。既知の空集合なら真。含まれる規範・命令を自動的に真偽命題へ変換しない。
90a3a8807a514c6237b91b7907097ff8952f950b.en: The propositional parts contained in the target within the reference context are all true in the evaluation situation. Known empty sets are true. Do not automatically convert contained norms or commands into truth-value propositions.

90b551d4ed88fc00fd7d2f7241da258197694e63.ja: withdraws: 人物・行為・記述・理由・状況に対する撤回の解釈関係。単なる記録の欠落から推測しない。
90b551d4ed88fc00fd7d2f7241da258197694e63.en: withdraws: the interpretive relation of retraction concerning a person, action, description, reason, or situation. Do not infer from mere absence of records.

90f61361d5f84790230f775ff15e68862e371573.ja: 言葉で述べる可能性を、留保を除いた厳密同値や発話済みと同一視しない。
90f61361d5f84790230f775ff15e68862e371573.en: Do not equate the possibility of stating with words to strict equivalence without reservation or with already uttered speech.

911882e295839c64a2a4efb63ca1a5ea3f360c7f.ja: この活動は指定作品を同じ公衆が取り上げて検討できるよう提供する活動として構成されている。単に作品名を言うこと、別作品の流通、宛先のない保管とは区別する。実際の提供・受領・読了・評価は含意しない。
911882e295839c64a2a4efb63ca1a5ea3f360c7f.en: This activity is composed as an activity that provides for the same public to take up and examine the specified work. This is distinguished from merely stating the work title, the circulation of a separate work, or storage without a destination. Actual provision, receipt, reading/completion, and evaluation are not implied.

9123ef6c97c9aaffb3e974627cf384a0f77bd133.en: The rational value on the right.

91253aeab20d4ddde98320eeaa005ac8a8915434.ja: 候補の採用から引用した状態を実行せず、未指定入力を真偽の既定値で埋めない。有限検査は全領域の証明ではない。
91253aeab20d4ddde98320eeaa005ac8a8915434.en: Do not execute the state quoted from the adoption of candidates, and do not fill unspecified inputs with default truth values. Finite inspection is not a proof of the entire domain.

912895a938bbdde95aa1d8850f29560637e22323.ja: background: 組の背景側の閉じた内容記述。
912895a938bbdde95aa1d8850f29560637e22323.en: background: a closed content description on the background side of a pair.

913017868586c2ead7e21ff00cbf42f3d0e11c51.ja: 同じdistributionとして物理的に同定した分布が、frameのeventにおける座標時刻timeの空間領域regionに保有するkindの符号付き総量を、同じ長さ・時刻・量単位とcontextでamountへ結ぶ。regionはその同時刻断面上の領域述語として解釈し、同じ物理領域の異なる点表現で総量を変えない。eventとtimeの対応及び単位は同じ座標規約に従う。単なる任意の加法的関数、領域を横切る通過量、物質点一個の保有量、時刻差分とは区別する。量の種類が既存zorなら、電気的作用の強さと二極性を表す加法的な電気量として、eirmと同じ符号・尺度の物理的規約を用いる。正負の相殺を許し、零量から空間領域や担体の不在を導かない。量の同定と単位校正を含む基礎的帰属であり、実測済みや保存則の成立を含意しない。有限な総量を持つ適用領域だけで成立する。
913017868586c2ead7e21ff00cbf42f3d0e11c51.en: A physically identified distribution as the same distribution connects to an amount with the same length, time, and quantity units and context, holding a signed total amount of a kind in the spatial region of a frame's event at coordinate time time. The region is interpreted as a region predicate on a simultaneous cross-section, and the total amount does not change with different point representations of the same physical region. The correspondence between event and time and the units follow the same coordinate convention. It is distinguished from a mere arbitrary additive function, flux crossing a region, the amount held by a single material point, or a time difference. If the kind of quantity is an existing zor, it uses the same sign and scale physical conventions as eirm to represent an additive electrical quantity expressing the strength and polarity of electrical action. Cancellation of positive and negative is allowed, and zero amount does not derive the absence of a spatial region or carrier. This is a basic attribution including quantity identification and unit calibration, and does not imply that actual measurement has been performed or that conservation laws hold. It holds only within an application domain with a finite total amount.

914e95f8af9fee3d196ec2d161c93bbc713558ac.ja: 更新の成功状態のいずれかで、指定位置がその個体を保持する。
914e95f8af9fee3d196ec2d161c93bbc713558ac.en: In any state of successful update, the specified location holds that individual.

9158e8afca5de161cf3a933f3ef558685c0c6f56.ja: 指定した状態の性質記述について、その状態にある場合の便宜さを評価するため、同じ本人と基準文脈で採用する仮定状況。対象の状態は閉じた性質記述で指定し、別の状態の候補へ自動的に交換しない。候補への採用だけでは記述された状態や目的の成立、低負担を認定せず、引用記述を実行しない。現実の履歴や別の評価の範囲とは区別し、未知の採用関係は補わない。
9158e8afca5de161cf3a933f3ef558685c0c6f56.en: A hypothetical situation adopted with the same person and reference context to evaluate the convenience of a state when it is in that state, regarding the property description of the specified state. Specify the target state with a closed property description and do not automatically exchange it for candidates of other states. Mere adoption for candidates does not certify the holding of the described state or purpose, nor low burden, and does not execute quoted descriptions. Distinguish from actual history and the scope of other evaluations, and do not supplement unknown adoption relations.

9167aab990f1c7dcd4ecf95059e2e654497c6065.ja: 同じ文書・提示文脈の指定文で、指定の正整数の著者脚注番号が印刷された局所的な付着箇所への参照。occurrenceはその文にある同じ番号の記号を本文順に数えた1始まりの出現位置。文全体や注本文とは区別する。番号が別文で再使用されても同一視せず、未知の付着箇所を補わない。
9167aab990f1c7dcd4ecf95059e2e654497c6065.en: A reference to a local attachment point where a specified positive integer author footnote number is printed in the same document and presentation context. The occurrence is the 1-based occurrence position of the same numbered symbol in that sentence counted in text order. It is distinguished from the entire sentence or the footnote text. Even if the number is reused in a different sentence, it is not identified as the same, and unknown attachment points are not supplemented.

917725f5fb44cae693d85a11535b82b8dad220f5.ja: driveunitはforceunitで表す力をchargeunitで表す電荷で割った局所的な駆動の単位である。数値qの電荷への力の数値は、この単位の駆動三成分へqを掛けて対応する。同じ系の右手直交単位基底で、符号付き電荷に対する力を区別する。閉回路を一周する仕事/電荷の積分値や、機械力そのものの単位へ置き換えない。具体的な電圧単位名は原文へ追加しない。
917725f5fb44cae693d85a11535b82b8dad220f5.en: driveunit is a unit of local drive obtained by dividing the force represented by forceunit by the charge represented by chargeunit. The numerical value of force on a charge q corresponds by multiplying q into the three components of this unit's drive. In the right-handed orthogonal unit basis of the same system, it distinguishes force for signed charges. It is not replaced by the integral value of work/charge around a closed circuit or the unit of mechanical force itself. The specific name of the voltage unit is not added to the original text.

918fb662d2ce39c53a22a7faa6bd5916f40622f5.ja: condition: 現在の参照列と状況に対する検査。
918fb662d2ce39c53a22a7faa6bd5916f40622f5.en: condition: A check against the current reference sequence and situation.

91ba8d1b3ed3078c94e3e22c83f90508697beec9.ja: 著者がこの考察範囲で、記述された長さ候補の条件を測定方法として提示する。値の存在や一意性、二方法の値の一致を主張しない。
91ba8d1b3ed3078c94e3e22c83f90508697beec9.en: The author presents the conditions of described length candidates as a measurement method within this scope of consideration; it does not assert the existence or uniqueness of values, or the agreement of values between two methods.

91bccfb53b370624b6ede6513dbe69b824925fc2.ja: この本人が同じ基準場面で自ら望む議論の量・程度の全範囲。長さ・回数・詳しさ等、文脈で同定する程度指定を指し、許可された量や実際の遂行量とは区別する。数値単位や有限の上限を原文へ補わず、本人の希望が空の場合も許す。
91bccfb53b370624b6ede6513dbe69b824925fc2.en: The entire range of quantity and degree of argument that this person wishes themselves in the same reference situation. It refers to degree specifications identified by context such as length, number of times, and detail, and distinguishes them from permitted quantity or actual executed quantity. It does not supplement numerical units or finite upper limits into the original text, and also permits cases where the person's wish is empty.

91bcfa87417833165c89dd2911c0a0847b07a13f.ja: targets/solicits/supports/undertakes/claimsの適用根拠は解釈入力である。これら社会的・志向的関係の一般理論を論理演算だけで還元したとは主張しない。
91bcfa87417833165c89dd2911c0a0847b07a13f.en: The grounds for applying targets/solicits/supports/undertakes/claims are interpretation inputs. It is not claimed that these social and volitional relations are reduced to logical operations alone.

91f59560b676ee60baf035a401e081ef58b98c38.ja: 同じ事務・機構・共同体・固定対象者・割当役割・規範源・政府・協調配置・目的を保持する。
91f59560b676ee60baf035a401e081ef58b98c38.en: Maintaining the same matter, mechanism, community, fixed target, assigned role, norm source, government, coordinated arrangement, and purpose.

91f5f69fd396b2ed0afd9de3ef704fb27951504f.ja: 同じ提示・帰属の文脈。
91f5f69fd396b2ed0afd9de3ef704fb27951504f.en: The context of the same presentation or attribution.

91fb5fef726c07d534809607388ab813395a8381.en: The identifier of the reason for adoption.

9205cab04511f08847ca413d016b57e23779874c.ja: requirementは同じtaskをその指定範囲で完了するために満たすべき規約上の必要条件の一つである。対象全体に値を与えられること、同じ対象に曖昧な値を残さないこと、要求された時間比較を保つこと等、当該課題の全必要条件を指定する。成功するものだけに範囲を狭めず、未知の条件を不成立又は空集合として扱わない。
9205cab04511f08847ca413d016b57e23779874c.en: A requirement is one of the normative necessary conditions to be met in order to complete the same task within its specified scope. It specifies all necessary conditions for the issue at hand, including that a value can be assigned to the entire target, that no ambiguous value is left for the same target, and that the requested time comparison is maintained. It does not narrow the scope only to successful cases, nor does it treat unknown conditions as failing or as the empty set.

921fa083c0284332037dc96a85818487e12f9b96.ja: 起点の要求があり、同じ本人・行為・活動に対する期限条件が評価点までに成立した。解除との排他性は要求しない。
921fa083c0284332037dc96a85818487e12f9b96.en: There is a requirement at the starting point, and the deadline condition for the same person, act, and activity holds up to the evaluation point; exclusivity with release is not required.

9224e6b68d8e4fcf6f6cdcdda649ee224454e1ba.ja: 指定過程・導体・系・状況・範囲の局所駆動driveに、それ自体に対応する独立の蓄積エネルギーを、指定時刻・energyunit・valueで帰属する関係。エネルギーは仕事と交換収支で扱う量で、単位は力と変位の積の基準に整合する。駆動が作用する間に供給源から移転する仕事、導体や磁石の運動エネルギー、既存磁場の蓄積エネルギー、電流による発熱をこの駆動自体の状態量へ付け替えない。否定はこの関係への合成条件で述べるため、この記号自身は有無を先取りしない。零値の慣用的な帰属を許すが、値の妥当性や非零性は合成で扱う。
9224e6b68d8e4fcf6f6cdcdda649ee224454e1ba.en: A relation attributing to the local drive of a specified process, conductor, system, situation, and range an independent stored energy corresponding to itself, specified by time, energyunit, and value. Energy is a quantity handled via work and exchange balance, with units consistent with the standard of the product of force and displacement. Do not attach work transferred from the source during the action of the drive, kinetic energy of the conductor or magnet, stored energy of the existing magnetic field, or heat generated by current to the state quantity of the drive itself. Negation is stated via composed conditions on this relation, so this symbol itself does not anticipate presence or absence. Conventional attribution of zero values is permitted, but validity of values and non-zero nature are handled in composition.

922e84cea59cfaa954c4cdebd17d79f6560d94a0.ja: holders: 記録からその記録を保持する主体を得る関数。
922e84cea59cfaa954c4cdebd17d79f6560d94a0.en: holders: a function that obtains the subject holding the record from the record.

922e9d0f5c497276b6938f1e5235bc5c17aff74e.ja: その事柄は、同じ本人の身体の病気・損傷・機能の不調を見分け、その防止・軽減・回復のための対応を判断することに関する。一般的な体力増進や好みへの助言だけとは区別する。病気が現にあること、診断の正しさ、措置の実行や成功は、この話題の関係からは導かない。
922e9d0f5c497276b6938f1e5235bc5c17aff74e.en: That matter concerns distinguishing illnesses, injuries, or functional disorders of the same person's body and judging responses for their prevention, mitigation, or recovery; it is distinguished from general advice on physical fitness enhancement or preferences. The fact that an illness is present, the correctness of a diagnosis, or the execution and success of measures do not follow from the scope of this topic.

9232331d8fb46af615271526000e74fafa9930cb.ja: この文脈で、その人物を仮定例の一人称の位置へ置いて比較する状況。現実の履歴や著者の自伝的事実とは区別する。
9232331d8fb46af615271526000e74fafa9930cb.en: In this context, compare by placing that person in the position of the first person of a hypothetical example. This is distinguished from actual history or the author's autobiographical facts.

9245f6118b88d4300ec8fe55168c2e15db8a42b0.ja: secondcases: 第二の種類の比較範囲。第一と重なってよい。
9245f6118b88d4300ec8fe55168c2e15db8a42b0.en: secondcases: comparison range of the second type. May overlap with the first.

9253f641e8a6f7d80d621d9867062015283d1e6b.ja: priorafter: 前更新の変更後候補列。
9253f641e8a6f7d80d621d9867062015283d1e6b.en: priorafter: the candidate list after the prior update.

925cffb3bf02e01bb1a762f750679d4e28b6a58a.ja: 計算の負担を小さいと評価する文脈基準。原文にない数値閾値は固定しない。
925cffb3bf02e01bb1a762f750679d4e28b6a58a.en: A context-based criterion evaluating the calculation burden as small. Numerical thresholds not present in the original text are not fixed.

92612d77fa6795c91bc77fc51afbbfa001b339ea.ja: 同じ参照グラフの全式を満たす二値の割当てが少なくとも一つある。
92612d77fa6795c91bc77fc51afbbfa001b339ea.en: There exists at least one binary assignment that satisfies all formulas of the same reference graph.

92814d5e91a5552be67221ad56dff1306f1f72d1.ja: 座標値の組から指定成分の実切断を取り出す。三位置成分は共通長さ単位ta、時刻成分は共通時間単位rbで扱う。役割以外の引数での値は使用しない。
92814d5e91a5552be67221ad56dff1306f1f72d1.en: Extract the real cut of a specified component from a set of coordinate values. Handle the three position components with the common length unit ta and the time component with the common time unit rb. Do not use values in arguments other than the role.

928f6078cf5db4976d638d988e25f02117f2b380.ja: 24一般関係の採用済み型・全引数・意味を保持する。
928f6078cf5db4976d638d988e25f02117f2b380.en: 24 retains the adopted types, all arguments, and meanings of general relations.

92945dcbd7b0449a48be03817bef39e8492b2cbd.ja: この記録が、同じ担体・系・出来事・文脈に対する、指定sourcebodyを発生源とする電磁的な力の寄与に帰属する。sourceconditionは場の源の分解と同じ初期/境界条件・他の源からの分離規約を指す。電気的寄与か磁気的寄与か又はその和かは、別の力の種類と合成式により指定する。力の数値が偶然一致するだけで源への帰属を推定しない。他の源の力や全力の記録をこの寄与と混同せず、零の寄与も許す。物理的な源別の記録帰属を基本規約として採り、別の物体に同時に等大反対向きの力があることや実験実施を内包しない。
92945dcbd7b0449a48be03817bef39e8492b2cbd.en: This record is attributed to the contribution of an electromagnetic force originating from the specified sourcebody for the same carrier, system, event, and context. sourcecondition refers to the same initial/boundary conditions and separation conventions from other sources as the decomposition of the field source. Whether the contribution is electrical, magnetic, or their sum is specified by another force type and a composition formula. Attribution to a source is not inferred merely because force values coincidentally match. Do not confuse records of forces from other sources or total forces with this contribution; zero contributions are permitted. Adopt physical source-specific record attribution as the basic convention, without encompassing the fact that there are simultaneously equal and oppositely directed forces on another object or the execution of an experiment.

92b7de9a12d4f6615441ec05b6f126368105881d.ja: axis: 指定した基底次元の軸。
92b7de9a12d4f6615441ec05b6f126368105881d.en: axis: the axis of the specified base dimension.

92c048fd3dc9bef1233284ffa3cf57e93580b992.ja: 遅い進行速度と長い待機、到達可能性と現実の成功を区別する。
92c048fd3dc9bef1233284ffa3cf57e93580b992.en: Distinguish slow progress and long waiting from reachability and actual success.

92c6999f440f216e20814013bab00f1ff1622820.ja: 信念・証拠はbook/rain、受領と情報更新はbook/roundから始まる複合語で共有する。部品は型と意味規約を指す語の綴りであり、部品名だけから真理や根拠の十分性を導かない。番号・ハッシュ・登録順から字形を生成しない。
92c6999f440f216e20814013bab00f1ff1622820.en: Belief and evidence are shared as compound words beginning with book/rain; reception and information update are shared as compound words beginning with book/round. The parts are spellings of words referring to type and meaning conventions, and truth or sufficiency of grounds cannot be derived from the part names alone. Glyphs are not generated from numbers, hashes, or registration order.

92cbd8dc8ae6522db0e92540263860deec17ae45.ja: 関係が未知なら実行器は停止する。前提不成立と未知は同一ではない。
92cbd8dc8ae6522db0e92540263860deec17ae45.en: If the relation is unknown, the executor stops. Premise failure and unknown are not the same.

92e2a03cdd210a3d42277b11c201a9e3d82f8701.ja: 同じ文書・箇所・評価文脈で、候補と文脈から真偽への閉じた役割記述によって指定された順序付き二個体・個体列から内容への関数の記述・状況から真偽への関数への参照を返す。既知の対応だけを保持し、未知の文書・箇所・役割・文脈を推測して補わない。役割記述や返す関数を実行せず、役割の現実成立、候補の唯一性、引用内容の真理を参照取得から導かない。
92e2a03cdd210a3d42277b11c201a9e3d82f8701.en: Returns a reference to a function from two ordered individuals and a sequence of individuals to content, and from a situation to truth values, specified by a closed role description from the candidate and context, within the same document, location, and evaluation context. It retains only known correspondences and does not infer or fill in unknown documents, locations, roles, or contexts. It does not derive the actual holding of the role, the uniqueness of the candidate, or the truth of the quoted content from executing the role description or the returned function.

92ebe40691de114ed3f20ebecb65b53cfdfa8efc.ja: 瞬間共動と前後の静止を区別し、共動系の力に旧系の成分をコピーしない。
92ebe40691de114ed3f20ebecb65b53cfdfa8efc.en: Instantaneous co-motion and preceding/stopping rest are distinguished, and components of the old system are not copied to the forces of the co-moving system.

92f5eb1bee0eba4aa7f04280676eea6319462849.ja: 同じ本人・活動記述・基準から、本人がその活動の試みに取り組むという仮定の背景に適合する候補状況。学習の成功・能力取得・著者の予想の正しさで選別しない。未取得のままの経過も候補になり得る。候補の将来への位置付けは別のtxで検査し、現実に試みが起きたとは断言しない。
92f5eb1bee0eba4aa7f04280676eea6319462849.en: Candidate situations compatible with the hypothetical background in which the person engages in an attempt of that activity, derived from the same person, activity description, and criterion. Selection is not based on success of learning, acquisition of ability, or correctness of the author's prediction. Progress remaining unacquired may also be a candidate. The positioning of candidates toward the future is checked in another tx, and it is not asserted that an attempt actually occurred.

931b7ab3599316976d9e09b076e2b3b67d8ef262.ja: 二つの個体と基準状況を受け取る閉じた発話ひな形の記述に、指定した三つの引数記述を適用する。
931b7ab3599316976d9e09b076e2b3b67d8ef262.en: Apply the specified three argument descriptions to a closed utterance schema description that receives two individuals and a reference situation as arguments.

932b6f5dfc402265f84a36db1b0042c78a7e733d.ja: 列がこの文脈で割合を評価する母集団を過不足なく列挙するという前提。調査標本を母集団の全体と無条件に同一視しない。
932b6f5dfc402265f84a36db1b0042c78a7e733d.en: The assumption that this sequence exhaustively enumerates the population evaluated for proportion in this context. Not unconditionally equating the survey sample with the entire population.

932c9805150d94838816c065c3d03c71fb233a9c.en: principal: the referent to which the utterance is attributed.

93750f3bcdbce2b5965f2f4d86a22d64dc0029c3.ja: 前提の利用・記述列・論理的含意・現実の前提真理は異なる。空の前提からの推論も明示できるが、出所集合が空なら別起源の裏付けとは認定しない。
93750f3bcdbce2b5965f2f4d86a22d64dc0029c3.en: Use of premises, description sequences, logical implication, and actual truth of premises are distinct. Inference from empty premises can be made explicit, but if the source set is empty, it is not certified as support from a different origin.

937623e1d33336de6d31d2e47958ede2b7771b08.ja: 同じ組織が、同じ定式化に対応するこの閉じた内容記述を、自ら公に示す共同の立場として採用している。別の内容の採用、個々の成員の私的な信念、内容が客観的に真であることとは区別する。
937623e1d33336de6d31d2e47958ede2b7771b08.en: The same organization has adopted this closed content description corresponding to the same formalization as its own publicly stated shared stance. Distinguish from the adoption of other content, individual members' private beliefs, or the objective truth of the content.

938e2734447615bc55f27e5307d2d43df17e5364.ja: disjoint: 二部分が同じ状況で重ならないという関係。
938e2734447615bc55f27e5307d2d43df17e5364.en: disjoint: the relation that two parts do not overlap in the same situation.

939309ee8f694c22e242b951e0516996beb1df16.ja: 固定アルファベットと共通375語を維持する任意profile109。
939309ee8f694c22e242b951e0516996beb1df16.en: An optional profile109 that maintains a fixed alphabet and common 375 words.

939441f861eeec4038f0c49c1712243b7d8e98ad.ja: left: 左の組または内容記述。型に従い、生成関数では閉じた記述を渡す。
939441f861eeec4038f0c49c1712243b7d8e98ad.en: left: the left pair or content description. Following the type, pass a closed description in a generating function.

93c887f82d46caa7268c5c6d05573644813767ff.ja: 同じ更新と参照位置に対して、どの個体が候補であるかを尋ねる型付き質問を作る。答えの存在や一意性を主張しない。
93c887f82d46caa7268c5c6d05573644813767ff.en: Create a typed question asking which individual is the candidate for a given update and reference position. Do not assert the existence or uniqueness of an answer.

93d6235f793ad7158c25b0ee644d2cf60d4e1868.ja: occurrencecountは列の出現を数える。countselectedは列全体の重複を拒否し、母集団の完全性や代表性は別途指定する。
93d6235f793ad7158c25b0ee644d2cf60d4e1868.en: occurrencecount counts occurrences in a sequence; countselected rejects duplication across the entire sequence, and population completeness or representativeness is specified separately.

93daf4fe115f7c47d5ad05306aa1a7569eaa3cc2.ja: 同じ記述内容と評価文脈について、注意を向ける価値と注目に値する基準を区別する。
93daf4fe115f7c47d5ad05306aa1a7569eaa3cc2.en: Distinguish the worth of directing attention and the criterion for being noteworthy, regarding the same described content and evaluation context.

93dc3a7e21d14ba5e4335200bf3f8f6f76999c57.ja: 非空の全行為者が、同じ候補対象へ作用する一つの出来事に参加する。
93dc3a7e21d14ba5e4335200bf3f8f6f76999c57.en: All non-empty agents participate in a single event acting upon the same candidate object.

93dd6a91e190ace79defc339bca9a32d3e1cd418.ja: order: その履歴での厳密な先行関係。
93dd6a91e190ace79defc339bca9a32d3e1cd418.en: order: the strict precedence relation within that history.

93ded4d3a27c63dda30e7ef5b4e19c04785437cb.ja: 回答はbook/akiとbook/fruitを主とする複合語、会話の採用記録はbook/townを主とする複合語で示す。既存字形を使う共有名の規約であり、部品の意味から回答の正しさや社会的認定を自動計算する規則ではない。番号・ハッシュ・登録順で字形を生成しない。
93ded4d3a27c63dda30e7ef5b4e19c04785437cb.en: Answers are primarily compound words of book/aki and book/fruit, and records of conversation adoption are primarily indicated by compound words of book/town. This is a convention of shared names using existing glyphs, and it is not a rule for automatically calculating the correctness of answers or social certification from the meaning of parts. Glyphs are not generated from numbers, hashes, or registration order.

93e682938450900a4b3bd19ec3305b8230e37dd6.ja: unit: 測定値を述べる単位の個体。
93e682938450900a4b3bd19ec3305b8230e37dd6.en: unit: the individual of a unit that states a measured value.

94203181836bf2c2c562349e6feaec1c782ad092.ja: 履歴、出来事の境界、完了条件、主体・対象、期間の選定を解釈入力として保持する。
94203181836bf2c2c562349e6feaec1c782ad092.en: Selection of history, event boundaries, completion conditions, subject/object, and duration is retained as interpretation inputs.

9446cb42bb063c49de1a3a1016d3ba2f43e5c4d0.ja: processextentを満たす同じ過程の前で内容が偽、後で真である。因果機構は含意しない。
9446cb42bb063c49de1a3a1016d3ba2f43e5c4d0.en: With the same process satisfying processextent, the content is false before and true after. Causal mechanisms are not implied.

9467dea289b6cef77eef5fb6e96822a166fcd8bd.ja: 後の箇所が前の箇所の指示を説明するという談話関係。同じ記述を繰り返すことや本文上の順序だけから自動認定しない。
9467dea289b6cef77eef5fb6e96822a166fcd8bd.en: A discourse relation in which a later passage explains the reference made in an earlier passage. Repetition of the same description, or textual order alone, does not automatically establish this relation.

946fc09b5ad181db657693aff1b7e9dc05d9424f.ja: 固定アルファベットと共通375語を維持する任意profile92。
946fc09b5ad181db657693aff1b7e9dc05d9424f.en: Optional profile92 preserves the fixed alphabet and the shared 375-word vocabulary.

94a77f5df8e26717616c9df9adf28a05eae21bab.ja: 提示者・行為・帰属先・役割・対象・記述・状況の声の帰属関係。
94a77f5df8e26717616c9df9adf28a05eae21bab.en: The attribution relation of presenter, act, attribution target, role, object, description, and situation voice.

94b8376cb64a3dc5642570efd76241f0617e2081.ja: その人には、その状況で問題となる行為に必要な理解能力が十分にある。実際に自ら使うこと、決意や勇気が十分であることとは区別する。
94b8376cb64a3dc5642570efd76241f0617e2081.en: That person has sufficient understanding ability for the behavior that becomes problematic in that situation. This is distinguished from actually using it oneself, or having sufficient resolve or courage.

94e40c99a7a58bf0047738d05d49ad9a06226d38.ja: 本人がこの状況で記述された活動を試みる。活動の成功、許可、勇気が十分あることは別条件。
94e40c99a7a58bf0047738d05d49ad9a06226d38.en: That person attempts the activity described in that situation. The success of the activity, its permission, or having sufficient courage are separate conditions.

94e9d17c3a6d9145b764464bde20613445a3e3f0.ja: 選択と機会の重み、程度/頻度/許容低下、適用期間と比較期間を区別する。許容低下を0に固定しない。
94e9d17c3a6d9145b764464bde20613445a3e3f0.en: Distinguish the weight of choice and opportunity, degree/frequency/tolerated degradation, and application period from comparison period. Do not fix the tolerated degradation to 0.

94eb410472726e414d5f6c2681e70629108665a1.ja: 同じ候補の生起・因果・結果を結び、割合の閾値を捏造しない。
94eb410472726e414d5f6c2681e70629108665a1.en: Connect the occurrence, causality, and results of the same candidate, without fabricating thresholds of proportion.

94f0760d6986c75f582025d9debac598e604f882.ja: 前提内容の真理を評価する状況。
94f0760d6986c75f582025d9debac598e604f882.en: A situation that evaluates the truth of premise content.

94f44ac7910f8b5884d84752acdb57c7e323a880.ja: この基準文脈で、指定の規範源が活動の許可方針を定める立場。方針を受ける人の学識者としての立場とは区別する。特定の歴史的人物や官職名、正当な権力の所有をこの参照だけで断定しない。
94f44ac7910f8b5884d84752acdb57c7e323a880.en: In this normative context, the designated normative source holds the position of establishing the policy for permitting activities, distinct from the position of the recipient as an expert. This reference alone does not assert specific historical figures, official titles, or possession of legitimate authority.

95216fbf6e4d979d07c264ca4d3661b9626f9ddd.ja: actors: この記述で固定する行為者の集団。所属を個体の性質として与える。
95216fbf6e4d979d07c264ca4d3661b9626f9ddd.en: actors: The group of actors fixed in this description. Assign membership as a property of the individual.

954194404c8c9584d804fb6f05666cd7c772e190.ja: 候補は個体から実数値への関数。四座標の役割と領域は、この取得規約とは別に本文で指定する。
954194404c8c9584d804fb6f05666cd7c772e190.en: A candidate is a function from an individual to a real number. The role and domain of the four coordinates are specified in the text separately from this acquisition convention.

9550524ba9e8055325f2efb9923462646f052651.ja: 同じ命令の提示に結び付けて取り上げる目的内容の閉じた記述。命令の実行内容と目的は区別し、命令が実際に目的へ適うこと、目的の実現、道徳的な正当性を含意しない。比較する間は同じ目的を保つ。
9550524ba9e8055325f2efb9923462646f052651.en: A closed description of the target content linked to the same command presentation. Distinguish between the execution content of the command and its purpose; it does not imply that the command actually fits the purpose, realization of the purpose, or moral legitimacy. Maintain the same purpose during comparison.

9553d8c719c98efaf3240c332d370c9e29cad223.ja: 同じ公衆・基準の議論で私的使用への一般的許可を述べる全ての本人・委ねられた職務の組。許可や成功した案がある組だけを選ばず、同じ本人に複数職務を許す。本人が人であり、その職務で理性を使う活動があることは利用側でzzpとともに検査する。
9553d8c719c98efaf3240c332d370c9e29cad223.en: All sets of persons and entrusted duties that state general permission for private use in the discussion of the same public and standard. It does not select only sets where permission or successful proposals exist, allowing multiple duties for the same person. It checks with zzp on the user side that the person is human and that there is an activity using reason in that duty.

956d112d65c26d80526927ca214712d1635a0e7d.ja: world: 同じ記述を評価する状況。
956d112d65c26d80526927ca214712d1635a0e7d.en: world: A situation in which the same description is evaluated.

95750a67a97233996cbaa79f9be02c986288aefc.ja: 同じ文脈・両語形・両語義・理由についての同義規約。
95750a67a97233996cbaa79f9be02c986288aefc.en: A synonym convention regarding the same context, both word forms, both word meanings, and reason.

959137eb459422e818cde2cf3a10caf35f4159fb.ja: 同じcontextにおいてkindの符号付き量のamountunitと場のfieldunitの積を、機械力のforceunitへ直す正の係数がconversionであるという校正規約。量種の極性と単位の正の尺度を固定し、電気量と磁極強度、場と機械力を区別する。場の数値や力との比例関係自体は別に合成し、名前の一致や特定のSI換算係数では代用しない。
959137eb459422e818cde2cf3a10caf35f4159fb.en: A calibration convention stating that a positive coefficient converting the product of amountunit for a kind of signed quantity and fieldunit for a field into forceunit for mechanical force is conversion, within the same context. This fixes the polarity of quantity kind and the positive scale of units, distinguishing electric quantity and magnetic pole strength from field and mechanical force. The proportional relationship itself between field values and force is separately composed, and name matching or specific SI conversion coefficients are not used as substitutes.

9592bc266ad956f0015117fbb5f63dbf03c32c66.ja: ri4に加え、前段階のri3を満たすが後段階には満たさない比較状況がある。正しく支持された情報が比較範囲内で厳密に増えるという拡大の候補。
9592bc266ad956f0015117fbb5f63dbf03c32c66.en: In addition to ri4, there exists a comparative situation that satisfies the prior stage ri3 but does not satisfy the subsequent stage. This is a candidate for expansion where correctly supported information strictly increases within the comparison scope.

959728de3f6c67fa455da9cdedfa00a8390ce153.ja: この状況が、指定対象の利益・善を実現する内容として評価される。単に害がないこととは分け、評価基準は解釈で固定する。状況が現実に起きたこと、特定の行為者の意図や受益者の実感は含意しない。
959728de3f6c67fa455da9cdedfa00a8390ce153.en: This situation is evaluated as content realizing the interests/good of the designated object. This is distinguished from merely not causing harm, and the evaluation criteria are fixed by interpretation. The fact that the situation actually occurred, or the intention of a specific actor or the actual feeling of the beneficiary is not implied.

95a2b027ca6dff76f1aaf6114f321914802852b7.ja: この判断が、指定対象の価値・長所を指定した評価基準の下で、この評定として評価している。同じ判断の主体・理由・支持は別の関係で結ぶ。評定は質的な個体として扱え、数値・価格・他者との序列・判断の正しさを自動的に要求しない。基準と評定の解釈は明示する。自分自身だけに限定した語ではない。
95a2b027ca6dff76f1aaf6114f321914802852b7.en: This judgment evaluates the designated target's value and merits under the designated evaluation criteria as this rating. The subject, reason, and support of the same judgment are connected by a separate relation. The rating can be treated as a qualitative individual, and does not automatically require numerical value, price, ranking with others, or the correctness of the judgment. The interpretation of criteria and rating is made explicit. It is not a word limited only to oneself.

95aed87906bd719cdc190041cfad4998f7c632cc.ja: この例の設定で、指定物体・系・状況・単位・区間・全有向断面の累積輸送量と電流履歴が、対象とする観測可能な電流現象の記録である。電荷輸送とその物理的作用を校正した測定へ接続して大きさ・符号・経過を識別できる量として読む。実際に誰かが測定済みであること、全空間の全物理量を観測したこと、用いた理論的説明の一意性は含意しない。原文のこの現象は後続の電流の大きさと経過を受ける読みとし、場の説明の同一性とは分ける。数値関数だけや測定不能の隠れたラベルを観測結果と認定しない。
95aed87906bd719cdc190041cfad4998f7c632cc.en: In this example setting, the cumulative transport quantity and current history of the specified object, system, situation, units, interval, and all oriented cross-sections are records of the target observable current phenomenon. Read as quantities that can identify magnitude, sign, and progression by connecting charge transport and its physical action to calibrated measurements. Do not imply that someone has actually measured it, that all physical quantities in all space have been observed, or the uniqueness of the theoretical explanation used. The phenomenon in the original text is to be read as receiving the magnitude and progression of subsequent currents, and is distinguished from the identity of field explanations. Do not certify numerical functions alone or unmeasurable hidden labels as observation results.

95ea7ae07610236f61d929c7a2b31bc248cf79f7.en: priorcontext: the context of the prior update.

95fef9a1b958a39ebefeab60231702b84266ca86.ja: 同じ文書・箇所・提示文脈で、閉じた役割関係の記述に結び付けて照合する、実数値から真理値への関数への参照。役割は本文で定義する。参照取得から役割の成立、存在の証明や唯一性を導かず、引用した役割や候補関数を実行しない。未知の参照を拒否し、役割に合う任意の値を選んだり値を補ったりしない。
95fef9a1b958a39ebefeab60231702b84266ca86.en: A reference to a function from real numbers to truth values, which is checked by associating it with a closed role relation description within the same document, location, and presented context. Roles are defined in the text. Reference acquisition does not derive the holding of the role, proof of existence, or uniqueness, and does not execute the quoted role or candidate function. Unknown references are rejected, and no arbitrary values matching the role are selected or values are interpolated.

96140d619c46e5d5342b0ecb72f91448db57f068.ja: duedescription: 期限の閉じた状況記述。
96140d619c46e5d5342b0ecb72f91448db57f068.en: duedescription: a closed description of the deadline.

9650dc381549f7270b90f91e9d4a838498318a16.ja: 指定された出所列の少なくとも一つが、同じ内容記述・状況について指定方向の支持を記録している。内容を実行せず、支持からその真理を導かない。
9650dc381549f7270b90f91e9d4a838498318a16.en: At least one of the specified sources records support in the specified direction for the same content description and situation. The content is not executed, and truth is not derived from support alone.

965c44d08d6cc5f56de9c641fd878aa22c2a2b0a.ja: 仮定内容の引用から六式の真理、実験の実施、発散条件や変換後の結果を導かない。
965c44d08d6cc5f56de9c641fd878aa22c2a2b0a.en: Truth of six formulas, implementation of experiments, divergence conditions, and results after transformation are not derived from quotations of assumed content.

96659e0fbce779ca2c2df24703e959f1d39aa2bd.ja: 同じ事例の同じ反作用の対象者を指す閉じた個体記述。描写の意図内容を閉じるために用い、元の対象者との一致はr2pjで検査する。

a71201aac227f42650827f0d6c16311312a6cb87.ja: 指定の人物・記述の組を変更前に加えた集合が、変更後の全記録と等しい。既存の同じ組の再受諾も許す。
a71201aac227f42650827f0d6c16311312a6cb87.en: The set formed by adding the specified pair of person and description before the change is equal to all records after the change; re-acceptance of existing identical pairs is also permitted.

a718de748015772d1a04e37e0cd5f16f5834217a.ja: 全該当出来事の進行範囲が整合し、そのうち指定範囲と重なる出来事がちょうど一つ存在する。
a718de748015772d1a04e37e0cd5f16f5834217a.en: The progression ranges of all corresponding events are consistent, and among them there exists exactly one event that overlaps with the specified range.

a71e318ed63bb8ad2da84bd55807fe871906743c.ja: 内容が未知でも受領記録は引用のまま保持できる。内容評価を要する受容・含意・情報比較は未知入力を拒否する。論理演算は短絡しない。
a71e318ed63bb8ad2da84bd55807fe871906743c.en: Even if content is unknown, reception records can be retained as quotations. Acceptance, implication, and information comparison requiring content evaluation reject unknown inputs. Logical operations do not short-circuit.

a72352d0efb60072ceade9fc1bb791a269282e98.ja: 信念は内容の真理・正当化・同意を含意せず、引用中の内容を実行しない。
a72352d0efb60072ceade9fc1bb791a269282e98.en: Belief does not imply the truth, justification, or consent of content, nor does it execute content within quotations.

a732e02edbe29c5e82a102127b7bba9395261660.ja: officesubject: 職務側の発話のひな形を適用する対象。行為者と無断で同一視しない。
a732e02edbe29c5e82a102127b7bba9395261660.en: officesubject: the target to which the prototype of the utterance on the office side is applied. Do not equate with the actor without authorization.

a735b67b5164cf64e8e56d08545c7dd3b5b32e59.ja: 同じ時間的履歴に属する状況の全範囲。観測された点だけへ無断で縮めない。
a735b67b5164cf64e8e56d08545c7dd3b5b32e59.en: The entire range of situations belonging to the same temporal history. Do not arbitrarily reduce it to only the observed points.

a74119f166f289eefc632af948b66ab4436aae89.ja: 集団が非空で、全員が指定性質を満たす。
a74119f166f289eefc632af948b66ab4436aae89.en: The group is non-empty, and all members satisfy the specified property.

a75a3b30feac7f64bab0ef7e21d82d65bc1ff364.ja: antecedent: 条件の前件。導入された参照は同じ条件の後件内で使える。
a75a3b30feac7f64bab0ef7e21d82d65bc1ff364.en: antecedent: the antecedent of a condition. Introduced references can be used within the consequent of the same condition.

a75c14ed6def4f962f68c729f4f4711fe69751d0.ja: 物理的な帰属、条件付き法則の採用、表記解釈、論述の提示と内容の真理を区別する。
a75c14ed6def4f962f68c729f4f4711fe69751d0.en: Distinguishes physical attribution, adoption of conditional laws, notation interpretation, and presentation of discourse from the truth of its content.

a764db8fba08b9dd7839fa6918e2ad770727a277.ja: assessment: 前後を通して固定する現実の真理の評価状況。
a764db8fba08b9dd7839fa6918e2ad770727a277.en: assessment: the evaluation situation of actual truth fixed throughout before and after.

a7865b9e61a8bb56a87a1fe10cfd8e577dcfccce.ja: 二つの内容が共に成立するという主張内容。これだけでは対比・期待違反・原因を表したことにはしない。
a7865b9e61a8bb56a87a1fe10cfd8e577dcfccce.en: The content of the assertion that two contents both hold. This alone does not indicate contrast, expectation violation, or cause.

a79bdaaba60da799ebe812f7784ac8a975007347.ja: 一個体引数の閉じた発話関数記述へ、閉じた対象記述を適用し、一つの発話記述を構成する。内容を実行しない。
a79bdaaba60da799ebe812f7784ac8a975007347.en: Apply a closed object description to a closed utterance function description with one individual argument to constitute one utterance description. Do not execute the content.

a7aea1c4fa39045d1bafed114d9310e4245ad72a.ja: 同じ主張/背景の組を段階3へ接続し、同じ著者・箇所・文脈へ、主張範囲と背景範囲を分けて帰属する。二内容の真理は要求しない。
a7aea1c4fa39045d1bafed114d9310e4245ad72a.en: Connect the same assertion/background tuple to stage 3, attributing to the same author, location, and context with the assertion scope and background scope separated. The truth of the two contents is not required.

a7b4f1883e5d7fce607e064a2ca50098fd68242f.ja: related: 同じ語形・文脈・左語義/意味・右語義/意味・理由について関連を認める明示的関係。
a7b4f1883e5d7fce607e064a2ca50098fd68242f.en: related: explicit relationship allowing relatedness for the same glyph, context, left meaning/sense, right meaning/sense, and reason.

a7b79553bfe06f48edfe1f84e245f535bd914e13.ja: 要求を出す制度・規範・立場の出所。
a7b79553bfe06f48edfe1f84e245f535bd914e13.en: The source of the institution, norm, or standpoint that issues the requirement.

a7dd04dad766c8a5c56d9594a58434ff1dde1bbc.ja: 字義と意図した内容の両方について、明示した関数記述と対象記述から構文を構成した結果に一致する。読みの妥当性・特徴対応・慣行の適切さは別の根拠として記述する。
a7dd04dad766c8a5c56d9594a58434ff1dde1bbc.en: Matches the result of constructing syntax from the explicitly stated function description and object description, regarding both literal meaning and intended content. Validity of reading, correspondence of features, and appropriateness of convention are described as separate grounds.

a7ebdbb580acabf170eaffcfd3935c8389b2a5e2.ja: 記録から同じ閉じた内容記述を得る関数。名前だけで真理を与えない。
a7ebdbb580acabf170eaffcfd3935c8389b2a5e2.en: A function that obtains the same closed content description from the record. It does not provide truth based on name alone.

a7f6f3cf619c412efa095aac310964a0e269ca19.ja: 27一般関係の採用済み型・引数・意味を保持し、4局所参照は文書内定義にする。
a7f6f3cf619c412efa095aac310964a0e269ca19.en: Preserve the types, arguments, and meanings of the 27 adopted general relations, and make 4 local references definitions within the document.

a80fab64827cbbd5cf88fa00bde016257569cb39.ja: 列の各容器について、割当先の同じ部分がその容器の内容である関係を同じ状況で満たす。量や内容の相違は主張しない。
a80fab64827cbbd5cf88fa00bde016257569cb39.en: For each container in the sequence, the relation that the same part of the assignment target is the content of that container is satisfied in the same situation. Do not assert differences in quantity or content.

a8187542965dd0a9e418b4e4c57097f0c413ad42.ja: 順序付き二個体の問い：指定候補は明示した肯定域にも否定域にも属さない。問いの答えでないことや処理系の未知入力とは異なる。
a8187542965dd0a9e418b4e4c57097f0c413ad42.en: Question concerning an ordered pair of individuals: the specified candidate does not belong to either the explicitly stated affirmation domain or the explicitly stated negation domain. This is distinct from the question having no answer or from unknown inputs to the processing system.

a81ea49e2d888c0a297a0adcd2b1b7a256288a41.ja: 指定基準系で二地点の空間的距離が指定長さ単位の値である関係。経路長や往復距離との同一化は含まない。
a81ea49e2d888c0a297a0adcd2b1b7a256288a41.en: A relation in which the spatial distance between two points in a specified reference frame is a value in specified length units. This does not include identification with path length or round-trip distance.

a823647a873c4cf733f9594de0e37a209bc924e6.ja: 閉じた枠を語形参照と意味記述へ適用し、その出現での内容を作る。枠は語形・記述そのものに言及でき、内容の真理だけで意味を代入しない。
a823647a873c4cf733f9594de0e37a209bc924e6.en: Apply a closed frame to the glyph reference and meaning description to create content at that occurrence. The frame can refer to the glyph and description themselves, but meaning is not substituted solely by the truth of the content.

a83632cbcf2c1342f3b2925c11a97ca9b2f82600.ja: 二対象の同じ状況でのamountatが成立し、種類・次元が同じで尺度換算後の値が等しい。二対象の個体同一性は要求しない。
a83632cbcf2c1342f3b2925c11a97ca9b2f82600.en: amountat holds for two objects in the same situation, with the same type and dimension, and the values after scale conversion are equal. Identity of individuals of the two objects is not required.

a838d5c12a5d8a4362be12bf852af70affc6f45a.ja: viewが同じquestionをpremiseに基づく実質的な探究として扱う。同じ問いと前提への従前の扱いを記録できる一般関係であり、実際の発問、既知の回答、前提の真理を含意しない。
a838d5c12a5d8a4362be12bf852af70affc6f45a.en: view treats the same question as a substantive inquiry based on premise. This is a general relation capable of recording prior handling of the same question and premise, and does not imply actual questioning, known answers, or the truth of the premise.

a85bcf2835b2001b41b6b518fa7fbb55c98fc58f.ja: 少なくとも一つ解のある同じ参照グラフで、指定節点は全ての解で偽。解なしを内容の偽と同一視しない。
a85bcf2835b2001b41b6b518fa7fbb55c98fc58f.en: In a same reference graph with at least one solution, the specified node is false in all solutions. The absence of a solution is not equated with the falsity of content.

a86373fd1b5c21a068bbec5d752b957aadc6e577.ja: 提示者がこの箇所・文脈の同じ主張記述の中で、指定した視点の担い手に帰属させる強い姿勢として、焦点の内容を緩めず維持するものとして示す。単なる真偽の報告や確実さの評価とは異なる提示上の働き。焦点の一個体・二状況は同じ主張内の対象者・先行時点・基準時点に対応する。担い手は描かれた視点であって、現実の発話者、実際の内心、著者の賛同や命令行為とは限らない。焦点内容の真理、義務や禁止の追加、制裁、聞き手の同意、量化範囲の拡大を含意しない。
a86373fd1b5c21a068bbec5d752b957aadc6e577.en: The presenter indicates, as a strong stance attributed to the bearer of the specified viewpoint within the same claim description of this passage/context, something that maintains the focus content without relaxing it. This is a presentational function distinct from a mere report of truth values or an assessment of certainty. The single individual and two situations of the focus correspond to the subject, antecedent time, and reference time within the same claim. The bearer is the depicted viewpoint and is not necessarily the actual speaker, actual inner state, or the author's endorsement or command act. It does not imply the truth of the focus content, the addition of obligations or prohibitions, sanctions, the listener's consent, or an expansion of the quantification scope.

a871e8d90e324de3d45755fa6048ec3eaed60104.ja: kind: 体積・質量などの量の種類。物質の種類や次元そのものとは別に指定する。
a871e8d90e324de3d45755fa6048ec3eaed60104.en: kind: the kind of quantity such as volume or mass. Specify this separately from the kind of substance or the dimension itself.

a88e2ca8662e5a961993cb31d7693535e5836284.ja: 同じ本人が職務上の委任と区別して、自ら理性を用い本来の読者世界へ向けて語る学識者の立場を、この固定基準で参照する。cdの分類と具体的な活動のr2ziは別に要求する。免許・学位・任命や、既に発言した事実を参照だけで補わない。
a88e2ca8662e5a961993cb31d7693535e5836284.en: This refers to the scholar's stance, using reason oneself and speaking towards the original reader world, distinguished from delegated duties, using this fixed standard. Classification of cd and specific activities of r2zi are separately required. Licenses, degrees, appointments, or already stated facts are not supplemented by reference alone.

a89501cee5aaeb02ed4da765c0fe6c0407c97e5c.ja: 同じ事例・宛先・基準で、この要求を受ける立場の参照。受け手の立場であり、命令者の職位へ取り替えない。後の公的／私的使用の分類をここで先取りせず、参照だけで実際の役職保持や要求の正当性を保証しない。
a89501cee5aaeb02ed4da765c0fe6c0407c97e5c.en: A reference to the position of the stance receiving this requirement, in the same instance, addressee, and standard. It is the receiver's position and is not replaced by the commander's position. Do not anticipate the classification of later public/private use here; the reference alone does not guarantee actual position holding or the legitimacy of the requirement.

a8ab3cd021f0a1ad61efa369fda5ab78408bdaba.ja: この座標系に関する物体の位置と時間、慣性質量と機械的作用の記述で、対象とするNewtonの力学方程式が成り立つという適格性。力を受けない物体の等速直線運動、力と運動変化の関係を同じ空間・時間尺度で記述し、座標選択だけで生じる見かけの力を加えない系を指定する。後続u0008でNewtonの方程式と明記される読みを採る。どの系が実際に適格かは物理的入力であり、座標系という名前だけから認めない。電気力学・光学の法則の成立、特定の相対速度・変換式・絶対静止をこの条件へ先取りしない。
a8ab3cd021f0a1ad61efa369fda5ab78408bdaba.en: A qualification that the Newtonian mechanics equations for the object's position and time, inertial mass, and mechanical action in this coordinate system hold. This specifies a system where the uniform rectilinear motion of an object not subject to force, and the relationship between force and change of motion, are described using the same space and time scale, and where apparent forces arising solely from coordinate selection are not added. The reading explicitly stated in subsequent u0008 for Newton's equations is adopted. Which system is actually qualified is a physical input and is not recognized from the name coordinate system alone. The holding of laws of electrodynamics and optics, specific relative velocities, transformation formulas, and absolute rest are not preempted into this condition.

a8cda903a20fbbf9002c2a4a3d32614791b91d10.ja: この共同体では、この役割に、記述された活動を担う公的な責務が制度上委ねられている。活動の第一引数は役割の担い手、第二引数は同じ共同体である。援助可能な技能、私的な好み、臨時の自主活動とは分ける。現に活動することや成功、個別の権限の全内容は含めない。
a8cda903a20fbbf9002c2a4a3d32614791b91d10.en: In this community, the described activity is institutionally entrusted as a public responsibility to this role. The first argument of the activity is the bearer of the role, and the second argument is the same community. This is distinguished from assistable skills, private preferences, or temporary autonomous activities. It does not include currently doing the activity, success, or the full content of individual authorities.

a8d5356201dabef817c241c5b14f1de24b8a4c8c.ja: 完全性・実在・出所の支持・基本関係は結果から逆算しない。未知入力を偽に補わない。
a8d5356201dabef817c241c5b14f1de24b8a4c8c.en: Completeness, actual existence, support of origin, and primitive relations are not back-calculated from results. Unknown inputs are not supplemented as false.

a8e1275a350d29a397624434dc641df055396c6d.ja: 指定時点の指定基準系・時間単位での時刻値。
a8e1275a350d29a397624434dc641df055396c6d.en: The time value at the specified point in time in the specified reference frame and time unit.

a8e4af220e40d3d431da37d1107feeb5aad23269.ja: この母集団の全人数と基準文脈で、数量の焦点に関連する比較条件の列。各要素は人数を受けて真偽を返す同じ型の条件であり、人数以外の性質や対象者は変更しない。予想する状況keとは異なり、確率や驚きは表さない。条件の選定根拠は解釈上の前提。
a8e4af220e40d3d431da37d1107feeb5aad23269.en: In this entire population and reference context, a sequence of comparison conditions related to the quantitative focus. Each element is a condition of the same type that receives the number of people and returns true or false, without changing properties other than the number of people or the object. Unlike the expected situation ke, this does not express probability or surprise. The basis for selection of conditions is a premise on interpretation.

a8ee5815407388310ac9e5efd191bc2dc6cd0368.ja: scope: 前後で固定する命題項目の範囲。
a8ee5815407388310ac9e5efd191bc2dc6cd0368.en: scope: the range of propositional items fixed before and after.

a942cdd9328d068b7afe1e4aa9791f502d56a7aa.ja: 二個体の問いから、少なくとも一つの第一対象と組になって答えとなる第二対象を尋ねる問いを構成する。各集合の直積が元の答えとは限らない。
a942cdd9328d068b7afe1e4aa9791f502d56a7aa.en: Construct a question that asks for a second object that forms an answer when paired with at least one first object from a question of two objects. The Cartesian product of each set is not necessarily the original answer.

a94d9cc2c67b8e77521f572e5adaf0220bf0bef8.ja: 同じ候補・全要求表・宛先・内容・極性・背景を保持する。
a94d9cc2c67b8e77521f572e5adaf0220bf0bef8.en: Maintain the same candidate, full requirement table, addressee, content, polarity, and background.

a953b770cdf4a7d62a9fda989f15afeced229378.ja: 同じsourceが同じprocessの放射に関与する物理的な源として占める全ての関連位置・時刻の範囲にpointが入る。同じframe・校正された長さ時間単位・contextで四座標を与える。これは源の物理的支持範囲であり、便宜的な代表点や成功した放出点だけに範囲を縮めない。対象領域へ届く波に関与する源の履歴を対象とし、源が一点、全時刻静止、単一の瞬間に放出済みであるとは要求しない。任意の数値関数から物理的位置を認定しない。
a953b770cdf4a7d62a9fda989f15afeced229378.en: point enters the range of all related positions and times that the same source occupies as a physical source involved in the radiation of the same process. This gives four coordinates in the same frame, calibrated length and time units, and context. This is the physical support range of the source, and the range is not narrowed to merely convenient representative points or successful emission points. The history of the source involved in the waves reaching the target region is the object, and it is not required that the source is a single point, stationary at all times, or has already emitted at a single instant. Physical positions are not certified from arbitrary numerical functions.

a9712d4b87509ac6d827bc6e5882f729de62d251.ja: 実際に提示する一人の受け手。
a9712d4b87509ac6d827bc6e5882f729de62d251.en: A single recipient actually presented to.

a98eca4f38bb900b6aa15155a53f600855f7f240.ja: 固定アルファベットと共通375語を維持する任意profile99。
a98eca4f38bb900b6aa15155a53f600855f7f240.en: An optional profile99 that maintains a fixed alphabet and common 375 words.

a9930325f2c023b45b7c73216552ba63acb1d9e0.ja: 同じ光伝播区間の記録から個体候補を取得する。欄0は光、1は放出元、2は放出出来事、3は始点出来事、4は終点出来事、5は始点時計、6は終点時計、7は始点場所、8は終点場所。欄は記録の成分位置であり語義番号ではない。物理的な帰属・真空条件・時刻規約は別の関係で指定する。未知の記録や欄を既定値で補わない。
a9930325f2c023b45b7c73216552ba63acb1d9e0.en: Obtain individual candidates from records of the same light propagation interval. Column 0 is light, 1 is the source, 2 is the emission event, 3 is the start-point event, 4 is the end-point event, 5 is the start-point clock, 6 is the end-point clock, 7 is the start-point location, 8 is the end-point location. Columns are component positions of the record and are not semantic numbers. Physical attribution, vacuum conditions, and time conventions are specified in separate relations. Do not fill unknown records or columns with default values.

a9b06d38dfe7b326de7b7c858349a88ca7e602ae.ja: 履歴内で起点より後、期限以下、評価点以下の時点を選ぶ関数。枠の妥当性はdeadlinevalidで別に確認する。
a9b06d38dfe7b326de7b7c858349a88ca7e602ae.en: A function that selects time points within the history that are after the start point, at or before the deadline, and at or before the evaluation point; the validity of the frame is separately confirmed by deadlinevalid.

a9d18b753647facd65476490469aad46077aa970.ja: その人の自然的な発達上の依存が、その別人による指導を必要とする。実際に指導されていることや制度上の義務とは別の関係。
a9d18b753647facd65476490469aad46077aa970.en: That person's natural developmental dependence requires guidance by that other person. A relationship distinct from actually being guided or institutional obligations.

aa1ceacc52694fd1a3cd36bf5e874dd25e96321e.ja: 固定アルファベットと共通375語を維持する任意profile106。
aa1ceacc52694fd1a3cd36bf5e874dd25e96321e.en: Maintain an optional profile106 that preserves a fixed alphabet and common 375 words.

aa2a21d5595e96043c7595447d5419b5ed0124d8.ja: 著者がこの段階から、指定課題に結び付いた記述目標へ取り組むと提示する。目標の達成、課題の解決、後続の提示完了は含意しない。
aa2a21d5595e96043c7595447d5419b5ed0124d8.en: The author presents that from this stage onward, they engage in work toward a description goal connected to the specified task. Achievement of the goal, solution of the task, or completion of subsequent presentations is not implied.

c16f72aa980ce582649036efc30ee55dd8c56094.en: denotes: the directive correspondence of antecedent location, object, and context.

c17d23a80400846f2b75f5fc093e2af184961cbe.ja: declines: 同じ行為に対する同じ受け手の明示的な辞退。
c17d23a80400846f2b75f5fc093e2af184961cbe.en: declines: an explicit renunciation by the same recipient for the same act.

c18dbbfb03e495405184ea0f874111cb08049763.ja: targets: 比較する行為記述の有限列。
c18dbbfb03e495405184ea0f874111cb08049763.en: targets: a finite sequence of action descriptions to be compared.

c1b1d410c981ff39eb86eccf9ae955d5ebecaa57.ja: occurs: 行為・状況の生起関係。
c1b1d410c981ff39eb86eccf9ae955d5ebecaa57.en: occurs: the occurrence relationship between act and situation.

c1c0d2db84dbda757ab6c01cd51a97344537bdfd.ja: rule: その推論記録で指定した規則の識別子。
c1c0d2db84dbda757ab6c01cd51a97344537bdfd.en: rule: an identifier for the rule specified in that inference record.

c1d4a8f0cdf659c7a4348679868ce9a2d5897238.ja: 同じ発話で同じ話者が同じ宛先へ、指定対象について、第一の発話に続けて第二の発話を対照的な留保として提示する。先行内容を撤回せず後続の制約も保持する働きであり、順序を保持する。単なる併置、第一の否定、二内容の論理的矛盾、第二の実行が第一の真理の必要条件であることとは区別する。各内容の提示は別に要求する。
c1d4a8f0cdf659c7a4348679868ce9a2d5897238.en: With the same speaker and same addressee in the same speech, the second speech is presented as a contrasting reservation following the first speech regarding the specified target; this is a function that does not retract prior content but maintains subsequent constraints, preserving order. This is distinguished from mere juxtaposition, negation of the first, logical contradiction between two contents, or the second execution being a necessary condition for the truth of the first. Presentation of each content is separately required.

c1d51e35ea304a5116d7cf3f291603dfc4c4007d.ja: この人物と文脈において、自立を試みる場合の危険という条件を評価する仮定状況の範囲。実際に試みたという履歴ではなく、前文の信念候補u2とも区別する。
c1d51e35ea304a5116d7cf3f291603dfc4c4007d.en: The scope of the hypothetical situation in which the condition of danger when attempting autonomy is evaluated for this person and context. This is not a history of actually having attempted, nor is it distinguished from the preceding belief candidate u2.

c1d644122b2d2388aef3027c59457915ca5220fa.ja: 同じ著者・提示文脈で、指定された箇所の一般的な叙述を、この箇所の具体的な内容によって例示する。どの一般叙述をどの内容で具体化するかを保持する。二内容の真理、単なる隣接、普遍命題の論理的証明や一般叙述の全事例の列挙とは区別する。
c1d644122b2d2388aef3027c59457915ca5220fa.en: In the same author and presentation context, this exemplifies the general narration of a specified passage with the specific content of that passage. It maintains which general narration is concretized by which content. It is distinguished from the truth of the two contents, mere adjacency, logical proof of universal propositions, or exhaustive enumeration of all instances of the general narration.

c2064d728aad51f67b11e19092aa73fd04764f97.ja: 事例の発話者と発話、本人の選択候補、先行事例列への指示を区別する共有語彙。
c2064d728aad51f67b11e19092aa73fd04764f97.en: Shared vocabulary distinguishing a case's speaker and utterance, the person's candidate choices, and reference to a sequence of preceding cases.

c20fd88247960a969e86b6291e8de697caf4bb98.ja: 同じ主体のbeliefacceptedと、同じ主体が保持する同じ記述の対象記録へのproofsupportsが共に成立する。根拠付きの誤信念も許す。
c20fd88247960a969e86b6291e8de697caf4bb98.en: Both beliefaccepted of the same subject and proofsupports of the subject's held record on the same description are holding; evidence-based false beliefs are also permitted.

c2483349a1493dd5483016be389fd50ca7a9ddef.ja: 指定物質線が同じ原点から出る。任意の離れた一点を原点として流用しない。
c2483349a1493dd5483016be389fd50ca7a9ddef.en: The designated material lines emanate from the same origin. It is not borrowed using an arbitrary distant point as the origin.

c255391fc047550a895553d6ecfeb63085873fa6.ja: この提示行為の表現・遂行の様式が、この受け手の怒り・憤りなどの反抗的な感情に訴えるものである。理由を冷静に示すだけの様式とは区別する。受け手に実際に感情や意欲が生じたこと、行動、因果的な成功、虚偽の内容は含意しない。発話に限らず理解できる身振りや表示も含み得る。
c255391fc047550a895553d6ecfeb63085873fa6.en: The manner of expression and execution of this presenting act appeals to the recipient's resistant emotions such as anger or indignation. It distinguishes itself from a manner that merely calmly presents reasons. It does not imply that the recipient actually experienced emotions or desire, action, causal success, or false content. It may include gestures or displays understandable beyond speech.

c25c4aa91cf8858629254ded30ea127bdcc24f4f.ja: 受け手の行為を対象とする提示に、話者が同じ役割に基づく指示権限を同じ発話行為で行使すると表明する関係を結ぶ。主張した権限の正当性や服従を導かない。
c25c4aa91cf8858629254ded30ea127bdcc24f4f.en: connect a relation in which the speaker exercises the same role-based directive authority in the same utterance act for a presentation targeting the recipient's act; do not derive the legitimacy of the claimed authority or obedience.

c25cd5961c45b191236d28d7aa1b9b25ac7e8bc1.ja: 同じ過程・系・二場・領域を物理的な記述へ結ぶ。
c25cd5961c45b191236d28d7aa1b9b25ac7e8bc1.en: Connects the same process·system·two fields·region to a physical description.

c2822ac4568ebaa166945c0fdc6bc04ca46a9858.ja: この制度的な構成では、同じ対象と基準を渡した第一の内容族のように振る舞わせることが、第二の内容族を目指すための仕方として位置付けられている。内容族は対象・基準の順に受ける。個人の心理的意図ではなく、設定された機能上の目的関係であり、手段と目的を実行せず、現在の履行、成果の実現、十分性や確実性を含意しない。
c2822ac4568ebaa166945c0fdc6bc04ca46a9858.en: In this institutional configuration, behaving like a first content family given the same object and criterion is positioned as a means to aim for a second content family. Content families receive in the order of object, then criterion. It is a functional purpose relation set, not an individual's psychological intent; it does not execute means and ends, nor does it imply current fulfillment, realization of results, sufficiency, or certainty.

c2a57705cf415f5f3637737583dedd2988b6d48c.ja: 指定した系・単位・設定での四座標変換の候補。観測された同じ出来事の対応との一致はsibで別に要求する。
c2a57705cf415f5f3637737583dedd2988b6d48c.en: Candidates for four-coordinate transformation in the specified system, unit, and setting. Agreement with the correspondence of the same observed event is separately required by sib.

c2aaaf25511e65f48760bacbdde2122fd3ff3acd.ja: subjectindex: 関係の主体となる参照位置。
c2aaaf25511e65f48760bacbdde2122fd3ff3acd.en: subjectindex: The reference position serving as the subject of the relation.

c2ab24334bdff85f6de96388a75289bbf2c7e1d3.ja: 同じ対象・量の種類・単位・状況について非負の読みが測定関係を満たし、次元と尺度が単位登録に一致する。
c2ab24334bdff85f6de96388a75289bbf2c7e1d3.en: For the same object, kind of quantity, unit, and situation, a non-negative reading satisfies the measurement relationship, and the dimension and scale match the unit registration.

c2b095c79552af85918fccd160aa2e9dcb81f9e0.ja: word: 語形または語彙項目への参照。内容の代わりとなる文字列ではなく、意味は別欄に保持する。
c2b095c79552af85918fccd160aa2e9dcb81f9e0.en: word: a reference to a word form or lexical item. It is not a string that substitutes for content; meaning is maintained in a separate column.

c2c419e1cdad0d48b0dde6913bc63a09d8c88295.ja: target: 同定しようとする提示対象。既知の固有名、別の参照、観測対象などを明示する。
c2c419e1cdad0d48b0dde6913bc63a09d8c88295.en: target: the presentation target to be identified. Explicitly states known proper names, other references, observed objects, etc.

c2d2b84018bc156875c65f74f9edf65c0c265c95.ja: authorがnodeで、documentの当該議論に用いる速度を、numericalの経路長・経過時間・速度値の関係で規定し、appliedの同じ区間・経過時間・速度値・状況への対応で物理量へ結ぶ。量の役割と順序はこの二つの閉じた型に固定する。等式の規定であり、ある実測値の報告、法則の実証、無関係な三数の式ではない。引用した規則をその場で実行することは要求しない。
c2d2b84018bc156875c65f74f9edf65c0c265c95.en: The author specifies, in node, the velocity used in the relevant discussion of the document, defined by the relationship between numerical path length, elapsed time, and velocity value, and connects it to physical quantities by correspondence to the same interval, elapsed time, velocity value, and situation in applied. The roles and order of quantities are fixed in these two closed types. This is a specification of an equation, not a report of a certain measured value, an empirical demonstration of a law, or an equation of three unrelated numbers. It is not required to execute the cited rule on the spot.

c2e262d780737c8c1c032f25f9e24141e3ffd08c.ja: 著者がこの箇所で指定targetの内容を、同じ提示文脈の先行箇所の論点を考える一つの具体例として取り上げる。先行箇所と例示対象を固定するが、唯一の例、全事例の網羅、例の現実化、例からの論理的証明は含意しない。
c2e262d780737c8c1c032f25f9e24141e3ffd08c.en: The author takes up the content of target specified at this location as one concrete example to consider the point of argument of the preceding location in the same presentation context. While fixing the preceding location and the example target, this does not imply that it is the only example, an exhaustive enumeration of all cases, the realization of the example, or a logical proof from the example.

c2e3b40a066fb0fec70e50ebf33b2548188e9ec1.ja: 著者が指定の前提のもと、前の内容を後の内容へ同値な形として書き換えて提示する。帰属関係であり、前提・内容の真理や同値性の検証済みを意味しない。
c2e3b40a066fb0fec70e50ebf33b2548188e9ec1.en: Under the specified premise, the author presents the previous content rewritten in an equivalent form to the subsequent content. This is an attribution relationship and does not mean verification of the truth or equivalence of the premise and content.

c2ff69d653e00978bedbd86ec2df977fee67f351.ja: 有限診断を全領域の証明とせず、比喩・予測・評価の帰属からその現実の真理を推論しない。
c2ff69d653e00978bedbd86ec2df977fee67f351.en: Do not treat finite diagnostics as proofs over the entire domain, and do not infer the reality of truth from the attribution of metaphors, predictions, or evaluations.

c306c677f6c739c77bb1365ab1aef1358906d4c0.ja: countedcontainersを満たす同じ内容割当の部分列についてamountsumが成立する。内容の重複や重なりを二重計上しない。
c306c677f6c739c77bb1365ab1aef1358906d4c0.en: For the same content assignment subset satisfying countedcontainers, amountsum holds. Do not double-count overlaps or duplicates of content.

c3175fa9d5eb87baecd4e5ec8154fdc7c5182a70.ja: 同じ方針案の本人・職務・関連背景を保って本人の私的使用の選択だけを変えた、要求への適合で選別する前の全選択肢の範囲。要求に適合するものだけや他人の違反を混ぜない。期間中と介入の両側で固定する。
c3175fa9d5eb87baecd4e5ec8154fdc7c5182a70.en: The scope of all options before selection by suitability to requirements, where only the person's private use choice is changed while maintaining the same policy proposal, person, duty, and related background. It does not mix only those suitable to requirements or others' violations. It is fixed across the period and both sides of intervention.

c3243b941e4163e669208c7808b224c1e6256879.ja: 原文の対象参照を説明する役割定義と、原文の主張・仮定・引用は別に合成して検証する。
c3243b941e4163e669208c7808b224c1e6256879.en: The role definition explaining the object reference of the original text and the assertions, assumptions, and quotations of the original text are separately synthesized and verified.

c33877cf98ae57f2538db6d57eae908e019eb85d.ja: その人が、受け手について記述された活動に関する判断・援助を行うための、体系的な学習や経験を通じて獲得した専門的な知識・技能を備える。単なる関心、一度の成功、資格の名称や保持からは導かない。個々の判断の正しさ、無誤謬性、現代の特定の学位・免許を含意しない。知識と獲得の経験的な判定には根拠が必要である。
c33877cf98ae57f2538db6d57eae908e019eb85d.en: That person possesses specialized knowledge and skills acquired through systematic learning or experience for making judgments or providing assistance regarding described activities of the recipient; this does not follow from mere interest, a single success, or the name or holding of a qualification. The correctness of individual judgments, infallibility, or inclusion of specific modern degrees or licenses are not implied. Grounds are necessary for the empirical judgment of knowledge and its acquisition.

c34191d589f1b4acf741279ddd1284d3f4a487ea.ja: 有効な二項目が同じ文脈・項数・順序付き役割を持ち、指定比較範囲でmeaningequivalentを満たす。語形と記述の一致は要求しない。
c34191d589f1b4acf741279ddd1284d3f4a487ea.en: Two valid items have the same context, number of terms, and ordered roles, and satisfy meaningequivalent within the specified comparison range. Consistency of glyph and description is not required.

c3566646d46d197649dc483cec117f8601a9da99.ja: 条件が真なら第一の閉じた内容記述、偽なら第二の閉じた内容記述をそのまま返す。記述内容を実行せず、同義性で置換しない。
c3566646d46d197649dc483cec117f8601a9da99.en: If the condition is true, return the first closed content description as is; if false, return the second closed content description as is. Do not execute the description content, and do not substitute based on synonymy.

c377fb8194d4c0bf7a2eeb3a2781aec89929bc94.ja: 同じ単位の進み率の差が、この参照率と比較文脈で「非常に小さい」に当たるという程度基準。正の差であることは呼出し側で要求し、具体的な数値閾値は補わない。
c377fb8194d4c0bf7a2eeb3a2781aec89929bc94.en: A degree criterion where the difference in the same unit's rate of advance is considered 'very small' when compared with this reference rate. The requirement that the difference be positive is imposed by the caller; do not supplement with a specific numerical threshold.

c3805724e8bbc092550a19411198263c55b5f65f.ja: 同じ批判活動と共同体について、この評価状況から見た事情に適合する可能な結果状況である。成功結果だけを事後選別しない。認識者の単なる無知、空想上の無制約な想像、処罰の許可、現実の結果とは分ける。
c3805724e8bbc092550a19411198263c55b5f65f.en: A possible result situation compatible with the circumstances viewed from this evaluation situation regarding the same criticism activity and community, without post-selecting only successful results. It distinguishes the mere ignorance of the cognizer, unconstrained imagination in fiction, permission of punishment, and actual results.

c38296d018986ed44365bcd9913cb4909c6355a3.ja: 同じ対象文章の提示と後付項目の区分規約を固定する。位置は正整数で、本文段落や前付の番号と混同しない。
c38296d018986ed44365bcd9913cb4909c6355a3.en: Fixes the distinction convention for presentation and post-text items of the same target text. Positions are positive integers and are not confused with text paragraph or pre-text numbers.

c38779c6a545554bd833ee7a874bbd003ff0789c.ja: local: 段階ごとの証拠の局所認定条件を返す。
c38779c6a545554bd833ee7a874bbd003ff0789c.en: local: returns the local certification conditions for evidence for each stage.

c3ab524c8be2e7f8a5ec3bdb4428981205841261.ja: 同じ事務・固定基準で、実行側の状況と不実行側の状況の結果の差に与える程度。程度対象は同じ評価観点に依存し、数値である必要はない。低下の方向と重大さは別々に確認する。
c3ab524c8be2e7f8a5ec3bdb4428981205841261.en: The degree to which the difference in results between the execution side situation and the non-execution side situation is given, under the same matter and fixed criteria. The degree object depends on the same evaluation perspective and need not be numerical. The direction of decline and severity are verified separately.

c3df7be2fc759cc7012d61d12216919d9a67c73b.ja: authorがnodeでtargetを述べる際、knowledgeを「われわれが経験から知るように」という挿入として提示する。知識の根拠付けが同じtargetへ向くことを保ち、別の現象の知識や、挿入を削除した単なる主張へ替えない。挿入の提示と知識内容の成立を分けて保持する。
c3df7be2fc759cc7012d61d12216919d9a67c73b.en: When an author states a target via a node, knowledge is presented as an insertion of 'as we know from experience.' The grounding of knowledge is maintained to point to the same target, without replacing it with knowledge of another phenomenon or a mere assertion with the insertion removed. The presentation of the insertion and the holding of the knowledge content are kept separate.

c3f3acf3128cb11c3e56391b03861d46e16397f2.ja: 同じ課題・文書・状況で、schemeの実用性をcriterionの共通の順序尺度のdegreeに位置付ける評価。degreeは質的な程度でよく、実測された数値・絶対単位・任意の好みとはしない。双方の評価基準と適用範囲を共有し、評価の成立と比較を分ける。
c3f3acf3128cb11c3e56391b03861d46e16397f2.en: An evaluation placing the practical usefulness of scheme at degree on the common ordinal scale of criterion, for the same task, document, and situation. degree may be qualitative; it is not treated as a measured numerical value, an absolute unit, or an arbitrary preference. The evaluations share their criteria and scope of application. Whether an evaluation holds is distinguished from the comparison between evaluations.

c42274e83a64c71e75b3390b8b18177b1b0b2450.ja: 本文統合と可視復号は別途確認する。有限束縛診断を全実数・全関数の証明としない。
c42274e83a64c71e75b3390b8b18177b1b0b2450.en: Text integration and visual decoding are to be verified separately. Finite binding diagnosis is not proof for all real numbers and all functions.

c43811ef6f3f5504ddf73a9772483bd6957f856b.en: The second content to be compared.

c43be24648ecfe2b58c29565943d784a0d877f3d.ja: 同じ内容と基準状況について、先行の議論と比較の前提を保って物理的帰結を評価する許容候補状況。候補は内容の真偽を調べる前に定め、後件が成立するものだけを選ばない。全論理的可能世界や規範的な許可とは区別する一般的な推論範囲の入力。候補の非空性と基準状況の包含、全候補での成立は利用側で要求する。
c43be24648ecfe2b58c29565943d784a0d877f3d.en: An admissible candidate situation for evaluating physical consequences while maintaining the premise of comparison with the preceding discussion regarding the same content and reference situation. Candidates are determined before checking the truth value of the content, and only those where the consequent holds are not selected. This is a general inference range input distinguished from all logically possible worlds or normative permissions. The non-emptiness of candidates, inclusion of the reference situation, and holding over all candidates are required by the user.

c4496991226465eeb38e0610339db36cacd2065a.ja: 同じ行為で指定制度・規則による状態の成立を宣言すると表明する。単なる状態の予測とは区別する。
c4496991226465eeb38e0610339db36cacd2065a.en: The speaker declares that the establishment of a state according to a specified system or rule is achieved through the same act. This is distinguished from mere prediction of a state.

c44e37f17a8ed76bfe6e951326277599f61ef131.ja: 真理値の数値指示関数。真を1、偽を0とする。この全条件をheでも記述し、割合の検査時に要求する。
c44e37f17a8ed76bfe6e951326277599f61ef131.en: A numerical indicator function for truth values, where true is 1 and false is 0; this set of all conditions is described by he and required during ratio checking.

c453de1b1bb3446b6d0d7564653d5eb99ba5f7d3.ja: 指定したbodyの巨視的形状に、同じframe・context・単位と閉時間区間を通じて追跡する二つの縦方向端面の中心firstend/lastendを割り当てる。二中心を結ぶ直線を、その物体の直線状の長軸として採用し、軸方向の物体の全広がりがその二端面の間にある。断面の横方向の広がりは許し、全物質点を軸上へ制限しない。中心は幾何学的標識でもよく、空洞の中心を物質点とする必要はない。縦方向・端面・中心の形状上の同定を与える物理的入力であり、任意の二点や測定標本から推定しない。数値の非退化性、履歴の座標帰属、距離、剛性、静止、軸への配置、並進は別の合成条件で要求する。
c453de1b1bb3446b6d0d7564653d5eb99ba5f7d3.en: Assign two longitudinal end-face centers, firstend/lastend, to the macroscopic shape of the specified body, tracking through the same frame, context, and unit over a closed time interval. Adopt the straight line connecting the two centers as the body's linear major axis, with the body's total spread in the axial direction lying between the two end faces. Allow spread in the transverse direction of the cross-sections and do not restrict all material points to the axis. The centers may be geometric markers, and there is no need to treat the center of a cavity as a material point. This is a physical input giving shape-based identification of longitudinal direction, end faces, and centers, and is not estimated from arbitrary two points or measurement samples. Non-degeneracy of numbers, coordinate attribution of history, distance, rigidity, rest, placement on the axis, and translation are required by separate composed conditions.

c8a7b1b3d9423847e0ea8ea9847965b4ba6412c6.ja: 同じcontextで、firstとsecondという二つの物理的な座標系の記述を、同じ出来事の座標を再表現するmappingへ結ぶ対応規約。両系の原点・軸の向きと尺度、局所時計の校正・同期・時刻原点を固定し、第一系の四座標を入力、第二系の四座標を出力とする。測定記録のある点だけでなく、当該座標記述の全域で同じ規約を適用し、未占有の場所の座標も含む。lengthunit/timeunitで値を表すが、異なる系での同時性や数値時刻の一致は含意しない。どの数値関数がこの対応を実現するかを物理的な軸・時計の設定へ帰属する関係であり、任意の数値写像だけで認定しない。特定の変換公式、相対速度、対象の静止、場・力の法則は含めず、別に合成する。実験実施や全実数点に物体があることは要求しない。
c8a7b1b3d9423847e0ea8ea9847965b4ba6412c6.en: A correspondence convention linking descriptions of two physical coordinate systems, first and second, within the same context, via a mapping that re-expresses the coordinates of the same event. The origins, axis orientations and scales, and calibration, synchronization, and time origin of local clocks of both systems are fixed. Input is the four coordinates of the first system, output is the four coordinates of the second system. The same convention is applied across the entire domain of that coordinate description, not only at points with measurement records, including coordinates of unoccupied places. Values are represented in lengthunit/timeunit, but simultaneity in different systems or agreement of numerical times is not implied. This is a relation attributing which numerical function realizes this correspondence to the physical setting of axes and clocks, not certified by arbitrary numerical mappings alone. Specific transformation formulas, relative velocity, rest of the object, and laws of fields and forces are not included and are separately composed. Experiment execution or the existence of objects at all real number points is not required.

c9dc8f79f4b0bd6bd09c1c4f623f4e02d0111731.ja: 著者がこの前提の記述に基づき、この結論の記述が従わなければならないと述べる。述べたという帰属であり、前提・結論の真理や有効な導出の検証を含まない。

dc39a0a5857d6a4706c535b655c8b58f68a3436e.ja: 受理する値は尺度内にあり、それより高い尺度値も受理する。空範囲・全範囲も許す。順序の妥当性は別条件。

dca7fa0d8d04d8e975b425ce84aa72f18360471b.ja: vectorが方向と大きさを持つ速度量の記録である。指定された同じ空間基底・基準系・長さと時間の単位による三つの実数成分で、位置の変化率を表す量として解釈する。成分表現はeisc5から取り、共通の既存軸yn/yo/ypへ対応させる。速さという非負スカラー、空間座標、力や場のベクトルと区別する。零ベクトルも速度の指定であり除外しない。点へ実際に付与することは別関係である。
dca7fa0d8d04d8e975b425ce84aa72f18360471b.en: vector is a record of a velocity quantity possessing direction and magnitude. It is interpreted as a quantity representing the rate of change of position, consisting of three real components based on the specified same spatial basis, reference system, length, and time units. The component expression is taken from eisc5 and mapped to the common existing axes yn/yo/yp. It is distinguished from non-negative scalar speed, spatial coordinates, and vectors of force or field. The zero vector is also a specification of velocity and is not excluded. Actually assigning it to a point is a separate relationship.

dcafe5474ce0e1a2f4d69c4867ef80bd46544ad5.ja: authorがnodeという現在の論述段階で、同じdocument・scopeのitemsの各箇所に、対応するcontentsの内容を順に一項ずつ挙げて示す意向を表明する。二列の同じ位置を対応させ、これから列挙に移る取組として読む。項数・対象分野・個別内容は引数で指定し、既に列挙したこと、内容の真理・証明・実験の実施は含意しない。単に将来の話題に言及すること、量を求める質問、既述の二法則だけの予告とは区別する。

dd87379ff69773bf6258af0c97967aeee886854d.ja: 物理量の帰属・極限規約・範囲の完全性は解釈の入力であり、有限の例から保証しない。
dd87379ff69773bf6258af0c97967aeee886854d.en: Attribution of physical quantities, limit conventions, and completeness of range are inputs of interpretation and are not guaranteed from finite examples.
